import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t')
from run import run

def doc(cases, events):
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":100,"cases":cases,"events":events,"channels":[]}

def case(name, frames):
    return {"name":name,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}

H = lambda **kw: dict({"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}, **kw)
D = lambda **kw: dict({"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x"}, **kw)
S = lambda t: {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":t}

out = run(doc([case("a",[S(5), D()]), case("b",[S(5), D()])],
              [{"at":5,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}]))
print('ordering:', json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('name','state','at','frames','response_frames')} for c in out['cases']]))

out = run(doc([case("a",[H(), S(10), D()])], [{"at":5,"kind":"close"}]))
print('close stops emission:', json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('name','state','at','frames')} for c in out['cases']]))

out = run(doc([case("a",[H(), S(5), H()])], []))
print('send error after end:', json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('name','state','at','frames')} for c in out['cases']]))

out = run(doc([case("a",[H(End_Stream=False), S(5), D(End_Stream=True)])], []))
print('no end:', json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('name','state','at','frames','request_frames')} for c in out['cases']]))

# datagram end stream ignored
out = run(doc([case("a",[{"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"dg","End_Stream":True}, D()])], []))
print('datagram:', json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('name','state','at','frames','request_frames','payload_bytes')} for c in out['cases']]))

# response for unknown stream ignored
out = run(doc([case("a",[H()])], [{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":7,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}]))
print('unknown stream:', json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('name','state','at','response_frames')} for c in out['cases']]))

# two cases, second gets the response
out = run(doc([case("a",[H()]), case("b",[H()])], [{"at":2,"kind":"headers","stream":4,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}]))
print('stream 4:', json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('name','stream','state','at','response_frames')} for c in out['cases']]))
PYEOF
